required.quote: Complete a minimum of 4,100 total credit hours in basic and clinical sciences, naturopathic philosophy, naturopathic modalities and naturopathic medicine. Of the total requisite hours, not less than 2,500 hours shall consist of academic instruction and not less than 1,200 hours shall consist of supervised clinical training approved by a naturopathic medical school.

experience_source.quote: An applicant who may register for registration as a naturopathic doctor must meet all of the following requirements:

exams.name: North American Board of Naturopathic Examiners (NABNE) national naturopathic licensing examination
exams.notes: Applicants who graduated prior to 1986 may substitute a state naturopathic licensing examination.
exams.jurisdiction: national (North American Board of Naturopathic Examiners)
exams.quote: Pass a competency-based national naturopathic licensing examination administered by the North American Board of Naturopathic Examiners or a successor agency that has been nationally recognized to administer a naturopathic examination that represents Federal standards of education and training, or has graduated prior to 1986 and has passed a state naturopathic licensing examination.

interval_years.quote: in no case may the renewal period be longer than two years.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a registration contained in this act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a registration contained in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of naturopathic medicine or practicing fraud or deceit in obtaining a registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of naturopathic medicine or practicing fraud or deceit, either alone or as a conspirator, in obtaining a registration or in obtaining admission to a medical college.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony or a misdemeanor relating to naturopathic medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony or being convicted of a misdemeanor relating to naturopathic medicine or receiving probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an accelerated rehabilitative disposition in the disposition of felony charges

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a registration or authorization to practice naturopathic medicine revoked, suspended, or otherwise disciplined by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a registration or other authorization to practice naturopathic medicine revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken or an application for a registration or other authorization refused, revoked or suspended by a proper licensing authority of another state, territory, possession or country or a branch of the Federal Government.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice naturopathic medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drug or alcohol addiction, felony drug conviction, or mental incapacitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice naturopathic medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of any of the following: (i) Illness. (ii) Addiction to drugs or alcohol. (iii) Having been convicted of a felonious act prohibited by the act of April 14, 1972 (P.L.233, No.64), known as The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act. (iv) Becoming mentally incapacitated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or a lawful order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or violating a lawful order of the board previously entered by the board in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection with or aiding an unregistered person to practice naturopathic medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection or association with a person who is in violation of this act or regulations of the board or knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unregistered person to practice naturopathic medicine contrary to this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may impose disciplinary or corrective action on a naturopathic doctor for any of the following reasons:

mandatory_fitness_examination_authority.quote: the board shall, upon probable cause, have authority to compel a practitioner to submit to a mental or physical examination by a physician or a psychologist approved by the board.

revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_.quote: A person whose registration has been revoked may apply for reinstatement, after a period of at least five years

felony_revocation_reinstatement_waiting_.quote: may apply for reinstatement after a period of at least 10 years has elapsed from the date of conviction.
